name: HAUS OF HUNZ
description:
HAUS OF HUNZ: A shared home management app for hunks only. Keep your chores in check, grocery lists organized, house notes flowing, and your fellow hunks accountable; with a little friendly competition and just the right amount of shade.

Because a fabulous haus doesn't run itself, darling.

We all wanna live in harmony, don't we? 💅
